prompt: Why might a component not receive KeyEvents even after adding a KeyListener?
choices: KeyListener requires a special constructor parameter
The component must have keyboard focus — call component.requestFocusInWindow()
KeyEvents are only sent to JFrame, not JPanel
KeyListener only works on text fields
explanation: KeyEvents are delivered only to the focused component. Call component.setFocusable(true) and component.requestFocusInWindow() to ensure the component can receive keyboard focus. JPanel is focusable but often doesn't have focus by default.
